activation: Only parent!==window and URL lessonSession matches /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,128}$/; standalone default unchanged.

parentLoad.round: NameleculeNameBuilderEngine.validateRound canonical round including bounded vocabulary, representations and stable roundId

rules: All events include channel/session; except startup ready they also include requestId/attemptId/moleculeId.
Both sides verify origin, exact sourceWindow, session, active identities. Never grant from solved flags.
Child verifies native viewer correctName and ordered piece text+separators match parent canonical before enabling. Roles may differ; compare semantic text, not DOM ID role.
Bank uses parent canonical round and bankSeed so IDs reproduce. Child restores only valid unique IDs; parent independently reconstructs/evaluates every snapshot.
submitted becomes false on any answer mutation; true only on Check. Attempts increments on Check. Child restores solved UI only from exact submitted canonical answer.
Child sends state after every answer mutation and submission, loaded after native ready. Parent owns triple next/final actions; child hides standalone Next molecule and own completion-navigation.
Success explanation is plain text supplied in canonical envelope. Existing answer/feedback UI and depiction/zoom remain reused.
Body ResizeObserver sends actual body bounds height (avoid viewport scrollHeight feedback loop). Parent expands iframe and uses outer lesson dialog as one vertical scroller.
Parent adapter may use invisible positioned start/end markers for controller revealResponse on child reveal. Child Escape posts exit; no cross-frame lesson arrow handling.
Frame removed/aborted on adapter destroy; nested native viewer destroyed on pagehide. Late callbacks rejected.

adapterController.optionalActions: Controller newPractice(context, gameId) passes third arg {game: gameId} to adapter.createPractice. Composite adapter otherGame(recipe,state) returns repair or builder. onOtherGame callback/otherGameLabel passed through existing generated set to optional renderer footer action, only after final success.
adapterController.close: Controller mount options onClose() closes to current checkpoint without granting access. Composite uses for child exit.
adapterController.migration: Optional adapter.migrateRecord(scenario,{signature,read}) invoked only when current sessionStorage record absent; read(projectedScenario) validates old key/version/full content equality. Composite returns {states,practices} with wrapped raw repair evidence; controller normalizes per adapter. No scanning or overwriting old record. Explicit present current record/reset wins.

recipeNote: The composite outer round can keep the same seven-key recipe values under a distinct registered checkpoint type; do not add keys to existing repair recipe.
footers: Parent Builder final actions and Repair final actions use .round-next and first continue button data-checkpoint-continue for supported focus handoff; onSuccessActionsReady only when enabled footer actually exists.
